name: artes-vivas-loja
description: Pulso Loja — Plataforma digital para el Festival Internacional de Artes Vivas de Loja (FIAVL)

scripts.specs:validate: pnpm run specs:lint:openapi && pnpm run specs:lint:asyncapi && pnpm run specs:lint:gherkin
scripts.dev: docker-compose up postgres redis traefik && pnpm run --parallel dev:services
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "pnpm --filter catalog-service dev" "pnpm --filter telemetry-service dev" "pnpm --filter gamification-service dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
